notes: Chinese product inspection report. The organisation line at the top (letter-spaced) is a letterhead (furniture), not a heading. Report number (top right) and "第 N 页 共 2 页" (bottom centre) are CSS page-margin boxes. The first table is a 4-column key/value form with no header row; the "检验依据" value spans three columns and is repeated. Results table: full grid, two-level header ("检验项目" spans 类别 and 项目; 序号/技术要求/检验结果/单项判定 span both header rows); category cells 外观, 安全性能 and 材料 span 2, 3 and 2 rows and are repeated. The notes list continues onto page 2 together with the signature line. Section headings carry TYPED Chinese ordinals "一、" "二、" "三、". The notes list has TYPED "1." markers with no space after the marker, and a nested level with TYPED full-width "（1）" markers. Lines wrapped inside a Chinese sentence join with no space; the spaces in "20 ℃", "506 mL", "1 m" are real spaces. The three signature names and the seal note are body text.
